kids.name: words
kids.chars: P1 Owner, the evening after a losing session. Follows the post-mortem path of 10:101: filters SCR-093 to the day and a tag, opens the loser, reads R and the stop path, jumps to replay, notes and re-tags. Predicted friction: a total that silently includes DEMO (F-1); a context chart that spins when nothing was recorded (F-4); an auto tag the owner cannot remove (F-5).

words.chars: P2b swing manager, weekly. Journal-heavy (10:112); scoped to granted accounts (14:2154). Predicted friction: a group trade counted twice (F-6); an export that does not say whose data it holds (F-7).

P3 Viewer, quarterly review with a screen reader at 200 %. 10:164 asks for tables and text summaries; 10:168 filters, exports, reads the curve and the per-tag table. Predicted friction: a histogram or scatter with no table (F-8); a stat read aloud without its sample size (F-2).
